items.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I didn’t get a chance to meet all of these guys... I know he was another great trombone player.

ctx.x: Do they call him the bumble bee or something?

I guess. But I mean and one of the great things about, I didn’t get a chance to meet all of these guys, but their personalities are just so great, they’re great people. Like I said Louis Armstrong is my, I would say is my, the one, if I had to choose one person that was most influential in jazz slash music to me I would have to say it was Louis Armstrong. But guys that played with him, Quentin “Butter” Jackson. I know he was another great trombone player. And he was also another one of the great plunger mute men.…
